title: Glessner House up close, back inside the full-detail budget
items: Standing on Prairie Avenue or 18th Street near Glessner House, the 1904 scene at full detail drew up to 4.7 million triangles, over its 4.6 million budget. Part of that was the sunlight pass drawing the shadows of houses beside and behind the visitor, shadows the sun throws away from anything on screen. Full detail now skips those, as Light has done since October, and the closest view on Prairie draws 4.4 million. Nothing a visitor can see changes: at all seven views tested, the picture matches pixel for pixel.
